review.notes: review of the change against main: 2288 changed lines since aecb53a. Checked every added or changed passage (origin, method and corollary labels; restricted 2.3; Layer 1 and Layer 5 text; scope, supplier contracts, references) and the seeded sample (0.1, 0.3, 0.6, 1.1, 1.2, 2.1-2.5, 3.1-3.3, 4.1, 5.2). Recomputed: the 0.6 transform quotient numerically at s = 3, the 3.5 functional equation against Mathlib riemannZeta_one_sub, the 3.3 exponent choice, the 2.3 contrapositive. 24 cross-roadmap citations resolved at this head. Sources read: the announcement, Pintz 1980 I, Kaczorowski 1984; the formal proof and the other cited texts were not readable. R01 (P1): Layer 6 (6.1-6.32) and 5.4-5.6 of the README on main, with four Lean declarations, are removed and renumbered in ConsequencesOfTheRiemannHypothesisForDirichletLFunctions instead of kept under their ids. Two small corrections: the 4.2 method parenthesis reads as false (chi_-4 is a real odd member of its cyclic family); the description omits the move and renumbering of 5.4-5.6. Automatic checks all passed; depcheck 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 7 sorry warnings only; #check signatures match the README. For the human reviewers: a record-rule waiver for the split, the Corollary-of convention, and the scope and licence of the formal proof.
